description_en: Queries the storage information for downloading a backup set
description_zh: 查看下载备份集的存储信息
name: DescribeDownloadBackupSetStorageInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides
parameters.name: region_code

parameters.help_en:
If the download destination is a URL, this parameter specifies the validity period of the link.

The default validity period of a URL is 2 hours (7,200 seconds).

You can set the validity period to a value from 5 minutes (300 seconds) to 1 day (86,400 seconds).

Convert the value to seconds before you pass it. For example, to set the validity period to 5 minutes, pass 300
parameters.help_zh:
下载目标为URL时，设置链接有效时长。

默认URL有效时长为2小时（7200秒）。
有效时长范围可设置5分钟（300秒）~1天（86400秒）。
请转化为秒（s）后传入该值，例如设置链接有效时长为5分钟时，传入300
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If you specify InstanceName, you must also specify BackupSetId
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

如果您填写了InstanceName，也需填写BackupSetId
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the download task.

If you do not specify TaskId, you must specify BackupSetId and InstanceName.

To view the task ID, click Backup and Restoration for the target instance and go to the Backup Download tab
parameters.help_zh:
下载任务ID。

如果不填写任务TaskId，则需要填写BackupSetId和InstanceName。
您可在单击目标实例中的备份恢复，在备份下载页签下查看任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only for MongoDB instances. It specifies the name of the sharded cluster
parameters.help_zh: 仅MongoDB依赖，分片集群的集群名
parameters.name: cluster_name

ExpirationTime.description_en:
The validity period of the link.

The value is a UNIX timestamp
ExpirationTime.description_zh:
链接有效期。

返回值为时间戳形式

PrivateUrl.description_en: The private URL to download the backup set

PublicUrl.description_en: The public URL to download the backup set

ErrMessage.example: Argument: regionCode Must not be empty

Message.example: Argument: regionCode Must not be empty

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否执行成功。返回值：
true：执行成功
false：执行失败
